mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, code, cfg_id, invoice_type, shop_id, so_id, so_code, platform_code, template_type, status, upload_time,bill_create_time, remark, file_url, upload_status,invoice_nature,platform_invoice_no,cancel_reason,return_tax_code,return_reason,invoice_remark
mapper.select: select DISTINCT i.id, att.attach_url, att.attach_name, att.type from invoice_info i inner join invoice_detail id on i.id = id.main_id and id.is_deleted = false inner join attachment att on i.id = att.business_id and att.is_deleted = false and att.attach_url != '' and att.type = #{type} left join shop_info si on i.shop_id = si.id and si.disabled = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and i.is_deleted = false and i.invoice_type = 'nfe'

select i.id, att.attach_url, att.attach_name from invoice_info i inner join attachment att on i.id = att.business_id and att.is_deleted = false and att.type = #{attachmentType} where i.is_deleted = false and att.attach_url != '' and i.so_id = #{soId} and i.invoice_type = #{invoiceType} and i.status = 'invoiceSuccess' order by i.id desc,att.id desc limit 1
